input: We have a multi-chip GIC-700 deployment: two SoC dies connected via a proprietary coherent fabric, each die has its own GIC-700 redistributor set. The primary die hosts the GIC-700 distributor and ITS. Cross-chip LPIs from peripherals on die 1 (the secondary) are not reaching VMs running on CPUs of die 0 (the primary). The ITS command log on die 0 shows MAPC commands for the secondary die's redistributors completed with no error. GITS_TYPER.PTA=0 on both dies, so we're using RDbase addressing. The GITS_BASER for device tables is the same physical mapping on both dies. Interrupts from local peripherals on die 0 work correctly; only cross-chip MSIs from die 1 fail. The fabric interconnect supports 64-bit physical address forwarding. The secondary die's GICR_CTLR.EnableLPIs=1. What GIC-700 multi-chip configuration registers and fabric address-decode settings should I audit, and what is the expected flow for an MSI issued on die 1 to reach a vCPU on die 0?
